purpose: Bounded diagnosis of ordered transform calls using the published faiss-imputer 0.3.22 wheel.

package.dependency_pin_basis: Versions supplied from the archived environment. These pins do not establish that every dependency or the runner matches the historical environment.
package.unlisted_dependency_versions: Resolve wheel dependencies, record their exact installed versions and wheel SHA256 hashes; do not claim historical equivalence.

warmup.operation: Fit and transform a separate small model immediately before the measured fit for each dtype, following the supplied historical worker.

process_isolation.dtype_order: Complete float32 calls 1 through 6, then complete float64 calls 1 through 6 in the same worker.
process_isolation.block_boundary: Delete the float32 block arrays and model, then collect garbage before the float64 block; retain interpreter, import and allocator state and record that fact.

output_retention.protocol: Retain the first output, a copy of the first output, and the previous repeated output during each dtype block, matching the supplied historical worker.
output_retention.repeated_output_comparison: Compare every repeated output with the copy of the first output and separately check that the retained original first output still equals that copy.
output_retention.between_call_evidence: Record array layout, non-copying hashes and structural/equality checks outside timers. Descriptive difference calculations are unnecessary for equal repeats. Save call-1 arrays only after the six calls complete. These additional audit checks are explicitly part of this diagnostic protocol.

reference.timing: After both timed Faiss dtype blocks in the same worker, so reference work cannot alter their warm state.
reference.tolerance_status: Criterion source pending. Report numerical differences and identity diagnostics; do not invent a KNN equivalence threshold or declare equivalence from an unsourced threshold.

stage_timings.timing: Separate instrumented replay after both timed Faiss dtype blocks and the KNN reference.
stage_timings.approach: Use supported low-cost train/add/search timing collectors where available; do not instrument the primary timed calls.

run_budget.second_run: Optional only after evaluating the first run and selecting the single strongest hypothesis. It requires a deliberate revised diagnosis; this revision does not implement or trigger it.
run_budget.global_run_count_enforcement: Human-maintained run ledger. Workflow attempt gating and the push token do not prove a global run count.

scaling_plan.measurement_protocol_status: Finalize after the bounded diagnosis and freeze before scaling; do not change the accepted decision structure.
scaling_plan.primary_endpoint: fit plus actual first transform; disclose excluded process warmup separately
scaling_plan.warm_reuse_endpoint: Separate secondary endpoint; freeze included calls before scaling, never replace the primary gate after seeing results.
scaling_plan.query_size_rule: Fixed 3000 query rows for every training size, including optional 500k.
scaling_plan.workload_value_gate: A dtype-only change does not qualify as a second independent workload. Treat complete_random and available_random as distinct policy/scenario workloads; retain separate dtype series.
scaling_plan.donor_policy_rule: Every measured cell records its series_id, workload_id and explicit donor_policy. Policy stays fixed across size points within a series.

active_development_gate.correctness: Existing predefined acceptance criteria must pass; currently unresolved criteria are not a pass.
active_development_gate.aggregation: Median of matched sklearn/Faiss runtime ratios; publish all seed/repeat evidence and all predefined series, including failures.

resource_budget.wall_time_scope: Full cell wall time including startup, generation, warmup and validation; report performance timing endpoints separately.

optional_500k_gate.missing_or_incomplete_prerequisite: Skip the matching 500k cell as resource_bounded / not_executed.

resource_budget.classification_rule: Budget skips and stops are resource-bounded outcomes, not performance failures. Apply eligibility independently to each matching method/policy/dtype/seed/repeat/environment cell.
resource_budget.paired_comparison_rule: If either method lacks a completed valid result, report the paired speedup as unavailable; do not infer a speedup or a gate pass from a resource stop.

environment_record.secret_handling: Capture only named provenance fields; do not dump the complete environment.
